Home Hotels & Resorts Fairmont Hanoi A living PORTRAIT OF MODERN HANOI Fairmont Hanoi, luxury hotel in Hanoi brings the spirit of the capital to life through refined hospitality, extraordinary dining , and transformative wellness. Home to 241 luxurious rooms and suites, the hotel features CIRUA Bathhouse , an immersive sanctuary of thermal bathing, hydrotherapy, and holistic rituals inspired by Vietnamese traditions. From grand celebrations to intimate moments, every experience is thoughtfully crafted to connect guests with the vibrant heart of Hanoi. GUEST SERVICES MAP & CONTACTS ON A JOURNEY THROUGH HANOI'S SPIRIT Immerse yourself in the vibrant soul of Vietnam’s capital, where every stay becomes a celebration of culture and connection. At Fairmont Hanoi, artistry, gastronomy, and wellness come together to create unforgettable moments, placing you at the crossroads of history and modernity.
